Ticket 2 uses 'Explorer' as in the docs. If the Board wants 'Data overview', the architect must reword AC-63 and AC-73 first, since 'overview' conflicts with AC-73's wording.

lessons.lesson: When new rules would route a dataset to a template that a later ticket creates, have the wiring ticket add empty template files so every ticket leaves the site rendering
lessons.when: A backend rule table change precedes the frontend page tickets

lessons.lesson: A Board answer that sets a title (here 'Data overview') can contradict an AC that forbids a word in that title; check it against acceptance.json before putting it in a ticket, and raise it as an open question
lessons.when: A gate sets client-facing text that an AC also constrains
